info.title: TempoFast API — Shop-scoped
info.description:
## TempoFast — Shop-scoped APIs

APIs for shop-level operations (inventory, stock movements, warehouses, production).

All endpoints under `/api/v1/shops/{shopSlug}/...` are scoped to a specific shop (branch).

### Resources
| Resource | Endpoints |
|----------|-----------|
| Warehouses | `/api/v1/shops/{shopSlug}/warehouses` |
| Stock Levels | `/api/v1/shops/{shopSlug}/stock-levels` |
| Stock Transactions | `/api/v1/shops/{shopSlug}/stock-transactions` |
| Stock Transfers | `/api/v1/shops/{shopSlug}/stock-transfers` |
| Stock Counts | `/api/v1/shops/{shopSlug}/stock-counts` |
| Stock Alerts | `/api/v1/shops/{shopSlug}/stock-alerts` |
| Material Batches | `/api/v1/shops/{shopSlug}/material-batches` |
| Production Orders | `/api/v1/shops/{shopSlug}/production-orders` |
| Disposals | `/api/v1/shops/{shopSlug}/disposals` |
| Zones | `/api/v1/shops/{shopSlug}/zones` |
| Tables | `/api/v1/shops/{shopSlug}/tables` |
| Shop Menus | `/api/v1/shops/{shopSlug}/menus` |

### Shop resolution
The `{shopSlug}` URL parameter is resolved by `ResolveShopFromSlug` middleware,
which loads the Branch model and verifies the authenticated user has access.

### Authentication
All endpoints require Bearer token in `Authorization` header.

get.summary: List Active branch menus active on a given day-of-week
get.description:
Returns Active branch menus that have an explicit schedule covering the given `dayOfWeek` (0=Sun … 6=Sat — Carbon convention). Status is hard-coded to `Active`.

A menu is returned only when it has at least one active, non-deleted row in `menu_schedules` whose `days_of_week` bitmask includes that day. **Always-on menus (no schedule rows) are excluded** — this endpoint is strictly schedule-driven.

Each row carries `start_time` and `end_time` from the highest-priority active schedule matching that day. The returned times are shop-effective — any `branch_schedule_overrides` for that (schedule, branch) pair supersedes the HQ default. Priority selection itself is HQ-owned; only the hours are override-aware. Time-of-day is NOT applied to the listing — use `GET /api/v1/customer/branches/{branchSlug}/menu` for the single live menu at the current moment.

200.description: Paginated list of Active branch menus active on the given day

start_time.description: Start time of the highest-priority active schedule matching the requested day.

end_time.description: End time of the highest-priority active schedule matching the requested day.

Định dạng theo quốc gia của tổ chức: JP インボイス `T` + 13 chữ số · VN mã số thuế. null hoặc chuỗi rỗng = xoá ghi đè, quay về giá trị brand. Sai định dạng là 422.

faq_inherit_hq.description: #1673 — chi nhánh có hiển thị kèm bộ Câu hỏi thường gặp cấp tổ chức hay không. Tắt đi thì khách chỉ thấy câu hỏi riêng của chi nhánh. Không nhận null.

get.summary: List this branch FAQ entries (own + inherited)
get.description: Own entries first, then HQ entries when faq_inherit_hq is on. Inherited rows carry is_inherited=true and are read-only here.

post.summary: Create a FAQ entry owned by this branch

delete.summary: Delete a FAQ entry owned by this branch

patch.summary: Update a FAQ entry owned by this branch
patch.description: A HQ entry, or another branch entry, returns 404 — a branch cannot edit what it only inherits.

patch.summary: Show or hide ONE inherited HQ FAQ entry for this branch
patch.description: Only HQ entries (branch_id IS NULL) have this switch — a branch own entry already has is_published. No row means visible, so turning it back on deletes nothing: it writes is_visible=true to keep who/when.

404.description: Not an inherited HQ FAQ entry of this organization

get.summary: List shop-level topping overrides for a floating section product

put.summary: Sync shop-level topping overrides for a floating section product
put.description: Replaces all shop-level overrides for this (floating_section_product, topping_group) pair. Pass an empty array to clear all overrides.

get.description: Returns details for the shop identified by {shopSlug}. The shop is loaded by ResolveShopFromSlug middleware, which returns 404 if the slug does not exist and 403 if the shop belongs to a different organization.

403.description: Shop belongs to a different organization

get.summary: Get per-menu timeout settings for a shop
get.description: Returns the full cart-timeout inheritance chain for this branch menu. All four tiers are included so the client can render them without additional requests.

404.description: Menu not found or does not belong to this shop

patch.summary: Override cart timeout for a specific branch menu
patch.description: Sets cart_timeout_minutes on the branch menu (tầng ④). Pass null to clear the override and fall back to the inherited value.

cart_timeout_minutes.description: Minutes after menu expiry before cart items are disabled. null = use inherited value. 0 is invalid.

404.description: Menu not found or does not belong to this shop

get.summary: List shop-level topping overrides for a menu product

put.summary: Sync shop-level topping overrides for a menu product
put.description: Replaces all shop-level overrides for this (menu_product, topping_group) pair. Pass an empty array to clear all overrides. Each row can set override_price (shop-specific add-on price) and/or is_hidden (hide the item from this branch's menu).

get.summary: List audiences scoped to this shop

post.summary: Shop-scoped broadcast (audience intersected with shop members)

put.summary: Upsert shop-scoped routing for a notification type

get.summary: Get order settings for this shop

enable_quick_order.description: When true, pos-web replaces the create-order dialog with a one-tap "Tạo nhanh" button that posts a floating order (no table/customer/guest).

service_charge_rate.description: Branch service charge rate (%) as string, precision 5, scale 2.

default_tax_type_id.description: plan-043 — branch-level default TaxType (tier-3 of the resolve chain). null = fall through to the brand default (TaxType.is_default).

prices_include_tax.description: plan-043 — 総額表示: when true, menu prices already include tax and the engine extracts 内税. Snapshotted per order; the PATCH flip is blocked (409) while a shift is open.

service_charge_tax_rate.description: plan-043 — tax rate (%) applied to the service charge, independent of item rates.

close_report_tax_breakdown.description: plan-043 — gate the per-rate 課税売上/消費税 block on the thermal close report (the Z-report PDF always includes it).

available_currencies.description: Selectable display currencies for this shop.

patch.summary: Update order settings for this shop

default_order_item_status.description: Set to null to reset to system default (pending)

enable_quick_order.description: Toggle pos-web quick-order UX (BR-SOS04). Omit the key to leave unchanged.

default_tax_type_id.description: plan-043 — branch default TaxType. Must belong to the shop's brand and be active (422 otherwise); null clears it (fall through to the brand default).

prices_include_tax.description: plan-043 — 総額表示 flag. Flipping it while any till at this branch has an open shift returns 409 TAX_MODE_CHANGE_BLOCKED_OPEN_SHIFT.

service_charge_tax_rate.description: plan-043 — tax rate (%) \/ 0-100 applied to the service charge.

close_report_tax_breakdown.description: plan-043 — toggle the per-rate block on the thermal close report.

409.description: Tax-included mode change blocked while a cashier shift is open (TAX_MODE_CHANGE_BLOCKED_OPEN_SHIFT)

get.description: Returns a paginated list of tables for the resolved shop. Filterable by zone_id, status, is_active, search.

post.description: Creates a new table in the resolved shop. status defaults to free, is_active to true, qr_token is auto-minted server-side. zone_id must belong to the resolved shop. Requires Shop Manager or Org Admin.

code.description: Unique per shop. Alphanumeric + hyphens only.

get.description: Returns a single table with zone snippet and last_status_change.

404.description: Table not found in this shop

put.description: Partial update. status and qr_token are NOT mutable through this endpoint — use /status and /regenerate-qr respectively.

zone_id.description: Must belong to the resolved shop.

post.description: Inactive tables cannot have their runtime status changed (BR-T03).

Transitions the table to a new runtime status and writes one row in table_status_changes. Allowed for Shop Staff (the only mutation Staff can do). Free transitions in v1 — any status can move to any other. Inactive tables are blocked.

500.description: Inactive table — cannot change runtime status

get.summary: List status transition history for a table
get.description: Returns paginated TableStatusChange rows newest-first. Append-only audit log.

post.description: Issues a new opaque qr_token, invalidating the previous one. The frontend renders the QR client-side from the returned token. Manager+Admin only.

get.description: Returns how many zones/tables would be created vs skipped if the brand defaults were applied now. Read-only.

409.description: Shop not linked to a brand

post.summary: Apply HQ default tables to this shop
post.description: Copies the brand's active zone/table templates into real shop zones/tables. Idempotent — codes that already exist in the shop are skipped, so re-applying never duplicates or overwrites. Requires Shop Manager or Org Admin role.

409.description: Shop not linked to a brand

get.summary: List active void reasons for this shop
get.description: Active void reasons of the shop's brand, sorted by sort_order.
Returns a paginated list of zones (areas) for the resolved shop, ordered by display_order by default.

post.description: Creates a new zone in the resolved shop. Requires Shop Manager or Org Admin role.

code.description: Unique per shop. Alphanumeric + hyphens only.

get.description: Returns a single zone with table_count.

404.description: Zone not found in this shop

put.description: Partial update. All fields optional. Requires Shop Manager or Org Admin role.

404.description: Zone not found in this shop

delete.description: Soft-deletes the zone and cascades soft-delete to all tables in the zone (BR-Z02). Restoring the zone does NOT auto-restore the tables.

404.description: Zone not found in this shop

post.description: Restores the zone but does NOT auto-restore its tables (BR-Z03).
Flips the is_active flag on the zone.

get.description: Returns active zones [{id, code, name, display_order}] for select/combobox controls.

qr_token.description: Opaque random base62 token. Frontend renders the QR client-side from this string.

tendered_amount.description: Cash only: amount customer handed over

reference_no.description: Card txn ID or bank transfer ref

refund_of_id.description: Set when this is a refund of another payment

sanctum.description: Bearer token from login or SSO callback

tags.name: Shop Schedule Overrides
tags.description: Shop manager APIs for per-shop start/end-time overrides on HQ-defined menu schedule windows. Each `branch_schedule_overrides` row stores nullable start/end times that override the parent `menu_schedule` row when present; missing fields fall back to the HQ default at query time via COALESCE.
